-- MODULE 1 LESSONS: AI Writing Assistant (moduleId=1)
INSERT INTO lessons (moduleId, slug, title, description, `order`, type, isPublished, xpReward, estimatedMinutes)
VALUES
(1, 'intro-ai-writing', 'Introduction to AI Writing', 'Discover the essential AI writing tools and the 4-Step AI Writing Workflow that will transform your professional output.', 1, 'text', true, 100, 30),
(1, 'rapid-email-drafting', 'Rapid Email Drafting', 'Generate professional emails in under 60 seconds using structured prompt templates and tone calibration techniques.', 2, 'interactive', true, 75, 20),
(1, 'long-documents-structure', 'Long Documents — Structure Before Content', 'Master the art of prompting AI to produce structured reports, proposals, and white papers with consistent formatting.', 3, 'text', true, 150, 45),
(1, 'tone-matching-mastery', 'Tone Matching Mastery', 'Learn to shift the same content across professional, casual, and persuasive contexts using AI tone calibration.', 4, 'interactive', true, 100, 25),
(1, 'refinement-and-editing', 'Refinement & Editing', 'Use iterative prompting to polish AI-generated content to publication standards — grammar, clarity, and brand voice.', 5, 'text', true, 125, 35),
(1, 'multi-modal-documents', 'Multi-Modal Documents', 'Combine text, tables, and structured data into cohesive AI-generated documents for executive audiences.', 6, 'text', true, 150, 40);

-- MODULE 2 LESSONS: AI Meeting & Communication (moduleId=2)
INSERT INTO lessons (moduleId, slug, title, description, `order`, type, isPublished, xpReward, estimatedMinutes)
VALUES
(2, 'meeting-transcription-basics', 'Meeting Transcription Basics', 'Set up AI transcription tools to automatically capture and format meeting audio into searchable text.', 1, 'text', true, 75, 20),
(2, 'action-item-extraction', 'Action Item Extraction', 'Prompt AI to identify, categorize, and assign action items from raw meeting transcripts automatically.', 2, 'interactive', true, 100, 25),
(2, 'ai-meeting-summaries', 'AI Meeting Summaries', 'Generate concise, stakeholder-ready meeting summaries with key decisions and next steps in one prompt.', 3, 'text', true, 75, 20),
(2, 'follow-up-email-automation', 'Follow-Up Email Automation', 'Automate post-meeting follow-up emails that reference specific discussion points and action items.', 4, 'interactive', true, 100, 25),
(2, 'agenda-creation', 'AI Agenda Creation', 'Build structured, time-boxed meeting agendas from a simple list of topics using AI formatting.', 5, 'text', true, 75, 15);

-- MODULE 3 LESSONS: AI Data & Analysis (moduleId=3)
INSERT INTO lessons (moduleId, slug, title, description, `order`, type, isPublished, xpReward, estimatedMinutes)
VALUES
(3, 'data-interpretation-prompts', 'Data Interpretation Prompts', 'Craft prompts that turn raw numbers and spreadsheet data into clear narrative insights.', 1, 'text', true, 100, 30),
(3, 'executive-report-generation', 'Executive Report Generation', 'Generate board-ready analysis reports from datasets using structured AI prompting workflows.', 2, 'text', true, 150, 45),
(3, 'trend-identification', 'Trend Identification with AI', 'Use AI to surface patterns, anomalies, and trends from business data that would take hours manually.', 3, 'interactive', true, 125, 35),
(3, 'visualization-prompting', 'Visualization Prompting', 'Describe charts and graphs in natural language and have AI generate the code or configuration.', 4, 'interactive', true, 150, 40),
(3, 'competitive-analysis', 'AI Competitive Analysis', 'Structure and execute competitive intelligence research using AI to synthesize market data.', 5, 'text', true, 175, 50);

-- MODULE 4 LESSONS: AI Presentation Creation (moduleId=4)
INSERT INTO lessons (moduleId, slug, title, description, `order`, type, isPublished, xpReward, estimatedMinutes)
VALUES
(4, 'presentation-outline-ai', 'Building Presentation Outlines with AI', 'Generate compelling, logically structured presentation outlines from a brief or bullet points in seconds.', 1, 'text', true, 100, 25),
(4, 'slide-content-generation', 'Slide Content Generation', 'Prompt AI to write concise, impactful slide copy — headlines, body text, and speaker notes simultaneously.', 2, 'interactive', true, 125, 30),
(4, 'storytelling-with-data', 'Storytelling with Data Slides', 'Use AI to transform data tables into narrative-driven slides that persuade and inform.', 3, 'text', true, 150, 40),
(4, 'speaker-notes-mastery', 'Speaker Notes Mastery', 'Generate detailed, conversational speaker notes that complement your slides without reading from them.', 4, 'text', true, 100, 25),
(4, 'design-direction-prompts', 'Design Direction Prompts', 'Write AI prompts that guide visual design tools to produce on-brand, professional slide aesthetics.', 5, 'interactive', true, 125, 30);

-- MODULE 5 LESSONS: AI Research & Summarization (moduleId=5)
INSERT INTO lessons (moduleId, slug, title, description, `order`, type, isPublished, xpReward, estimatedMinutes)
VALUES
(5, 'research-prompt-frameworks', 'Research Prompt Frameworks', 'Master the PEEL and SCQA frameworks for structuring AI research prompts that produce thorough, cited outputs.', 1, 'text', true, 100, 30),
(5, 'source-synthesis', 'Source Synthesis Techniques', 'Combine multiple sources into a single coherent AI-generated synthesis document with attribution.', 2, 'text', true, 125, 35),
(5, 'executive-briefings', 'Executive Briefing Documents', 'Produce one-page executive briefings from lengthy reports using AI summarization and prioritization.', 3, 'interactive', true, 150, 40),
(5, 'literature-review-ai', 'AI-Assisted Literature Reviews', 'Use AI to survey academic and industry literature, identify key themes, and structure a review.', 4, 'text', true, 175, 50),
(5, 'fact-checking-workflow', 'AI Fact-Checking Workflow', 'Build a systematic process for verifying AI-generated claims and maintaining research integrity.', 5, 'text', true, 125, 30);

-- MODULE 6 LESSONS: AI Workflow Automation (moduleId=6)
INSERT INTO lessons (moduleId, slug, title, description, `order`, type, isPublished, xpReward, estimatedMinutes)
VALUES
(6, 'workflow-mapping-ai', 'Workflow Mapping with AI', 'Use AI to identify, document, and map repetitive business processes that are candidates for automation.', 1, 'text', true, 125, 35),
(6, 'prompt-chaining', 'Prompt Chaining Techniques', 'Build multi-step AI workflows where the output of one prompt becomes the input of the next.', 2, 'interactive', true, 175, 45),
(6, 'automation-tool-integration', 'Automation Tool Integration', 'Connect AI outputs to tools like Zapier, Make, and Notion to create end-to-end automated pipelines.', 3, 'text', true, 200, 55),
(6, 'approval-workflow-automation', 'Approval Workflow Automation', 'Design AI-assisted approval chains that draft, route, and track decisions without manual intervention.', 4, 'interactive', true, 175, 45),
(6, 'measuring-automation-roi', 'Measuring Automation ROI', 'Calculate and communicate the business value of AI automation initiatives to stakeholders.', 5, 'text', true, 150, 35);

-- MODULE 7 LESSONS: AI Client Communications (moduleId=7)
INSERT INTO lessons (moduleId, slug, title, description, `order`, type, isPublished, xpReward, estimatedMinutes)
VALUES
(7, 'proposal-generation', 'AI Proposal Generation', 'Generate tailored, persuasive client proposals from a brief using AI — including scope, pricing narrative, and value props.', 1, 'text', true, 150, 40),
(7, 'personalization-at-scale', 'Personalization at Scale', 'Use AI to personalize outreach and follow-up communications for dozens of clients without losing authenticity.', 2, 'interactive', true, 125, 30),
(7, 'objection-handling-scripts', 'Objection Handling Scripts', 'Prompt AI to generate context-aware objection responses for sales and client success conversations.', 3, 'text', true, 125, 30),
(7, 'relationship-nurture-sequences', 'Relationship Nurture Sequences', 'Build AI-generated email nurture sequences that maintain client relationships between project engagements.', 4, 'interactive', true, 150, 35),
(7, 'client-reporting-automation', 'Client Reporting Automation', 'Automate the generation of client-facing progress reports, status updates, and performance summaries.', 5, 'text', true, 175, 45);
